OAI.PiExponent.LiteralAnalytic.norm_actu.natural_language_statement: For original fixed data $d$, $\nu\ge0$, $H>0$, a column selection and a choice family $f$, the norm of the literal summand $\bigl(\prod_r choiceScalar_d(r,f(r))\bigr)\det(choiceMatrix_d(selection,f))$ is at most the exponential with exactly the source collision, analytic-error and mean-row-weight exponent. All binders, finite domains and hypotheses are precisely the accompanying original formal statement.

OAI.PiExponent.LiteralAnalytic.actual_mi.natural_language_statement: The original selected-minor determinant equals the finite sum, over choice families $f$, of the original scalar product times the choice-matrix determinant. All binders, finite domains and hypotheses are precisely the accompanying original formal statement.

OAI.PiExponent.LiteralAnalytic.card_choi.natural_language_statement: The number of choice families is at most $translationTermCount(d.m,d.v_0,H)^{actualRowCount_d(H)}$ under the exact source hypotheses. All binders, finite domains and hypotheses are precisely the accompanying original formal statement.

OAI.PiExponent.LiteralAnalytic.actualRow.natural_language_statement: For original fixed data $d$ and $H>0$, the actual row count is positive: $actualRowCount_d(H)>0$. All binders, finite domains and hypotheses are precisely the accompanying original formal statement.

OAI.PiExponent.LiteralAnalytic.indexWeig.natural_language_statement: Each transverse index has nonnegative weight: $indexWeight_d(a)\ge0$. All binders, finite domains and hypotheses are precisely the accompanying original formal statement.

OAI.PiExponent.LiteralAnalytic.rowWeight.natural_language_statement: If the original scalar for row $r$ and row choice $t$ is nonzero, then $rowWeight_d(r)\le indexWeight_d(t.1)$. All binders, finite domains and hypotheses are precisely the accompanying original formal statement.

OAI.PiExponent.LiteralAnalytic.sum_rowWe.natural_language_statement: For $H>0$, the total row weight satisfies $\sum_r rowWeight_d(r)=actualRowCount_d(H)\,H\,actualMean_d(H)$. All binders, finite domains and hypotheses are precisely the accompanying original formal statement.

OAI.PiExponent.LiteralAnalytic.low_trans.natural_language_statement: The number of transverse indices of weight at most $d.A\,H$ is at most $lowIndexCount_d(H)$. All binders, finite domains and hypotheses are precisely the accompanying original formal statement.

OAI.PiExponent.LiteralAnalytic.lowIndexC.natural_language_statement: For $H>0$, the low-index count is positive: $lowIndexCount_d(H)>0$. All binders, finite domains and hypotheses are precisely the accompanying original formal statement.

OAI.PiExponent.LiteralAnalytic.norm_scal.natural_language_statement: For $\nu\ge0$ and $H>0$, the original scalar product norm is bounded by the exponential of the source weight difference and translation-error budget. All binders, finite domains and hypotheses are precisely the accompanying original formal statement.

OAI.PiExponent.LiteralAnalytic.norm_choi.natural_language_statement: For $H>0$, the original choice-matrix determinant norm is bounded by the exponential of its source multiplicity-square collision penalty and holomorphic-error budget. All binders, finite domains and hypotheses are precisely the accompanying original formal statement.
